place.source_title: C. W. Swain Building, 120 North High Street

brief: Three-storey 1896 commercial and apartment block on the courthouse square: brick with a corner turret, bay windows and a decorated cornice, two storefronts below and flats upstairs. Record gap: no photographs; 6 measured sheets (site, plans, elevations).

facade.notes: HABS title sheet: the C. W. Swain Building (Muncie IN, 1896), 'a commercial/apartment block ... on Muncie's courthouse square ... a typical example of commercial architecture in the Midwest at the turn of the century'; the site plan shows it on the corner of High and Washington streets

why.note: shops below, apartments above: the courthouse-square block
